safety.text: Shah says he would fully fund police and take action to reduce gun violence and stop fentanyl trafficking.
safety.quote: In Congress, he’ll continue to work to keep our communities safe by taking action to reduce gun violence, fully funding our police, and stopping the flow of fentanyl across the border.

abortion.text: He says reproductive-health decisions should be made by a woman and her provider and supports codifying Roe v. Wade.
abortion.quote: Amish believes that only a woman and her provider should make decisions about reproductive healthcare.

health.text: He says he would expand health coverage, protect Medicare, and lower prescription drug prices.
health.quote: In Congress, Amish will work to expand coverage, protect Medicare, and lower prescription drug prices.

trade.text: She calls for free markets and voluntary trade without government interference.
trade.quote: unleash free markets and voluntary trade without government interference

schools.text: She supported federal tax credits or scholarships to let parents choose private school, homeschool, or online programs.
schools.quote: Provide tax credits and cut taxes wherever and whenever possible until one day we can eventually abolishing the IRS entirely.

abortion.text: She supported prohibiting federal funds for organizations that perform, promote, or refer for abortion.
abortion.quote: The federal government shouldn't be involved in using tax dollars for government-managed 'healthcare' or 'deathcare.'

health.text: She opposes federal tax funding for government-managed health care except direct emergency services.
health.quote: Unless it involves a direct emergency service, the federal government has no constitutional role in funding these programs.

tax.text: Feely says he would expand Trump-era tax cuts and supports ending taxes on tips and overtime.
tax.quote: In Congress, I’ll fight to slash red tape, expand Trump-era tax cuts, unleash domestic manufacturing, and drive down inflation.

trade.text: Feely defended using tariffs as leverage to seek trade terms he considers better for the United States.
trade.quote: Everything he does is about leverage to get the best deal for America.

debt.text: He says reducing the national debt requires addressing mandatory spending, including a discussion of Social Security's finances.
debt.quote: the only way that you can deal with 40 trillion in debt going at a trillion every hundred days is to deal with all the mandated spending.

housing.text: Feely said cutting regulations could reduce housing costs and help homes get built faster.
housing.quote: And you get rid of regulation, housing costs, about a quarter of the housing costs is because of regulation.

safety.text: Feely says he would fully back police, Border Patrol, and ICE agents.
safety.quote: That includes supporting mass deportations of violent offenders, fully backing our police, Border Patrol and ICE agents, and working to eradicate fentanyl before it reaches our neighborhoods.

immigration.text: Feely says he would support mass deportations of violent offenders and finish the border wall.
immigration.quote: In Congress, I’ll fight to finish the wall, dismantle the Biden/Harris open-borders agenda, and deliver results.

guns.text: Feely says he would defend Second Amendment rights and opposes federal mandates he says harm families and businesses.
guns.quote: That means protecting our water, standing up for our farmers and ranchers, defending our Second Amendment rights, and stopping out-of-control federal mandates that hurt our families, small businesses, and schools.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Feely says he would support laws to keep girls’ and women’s sports for female competitors.
gender.quote: In Congress, I will fight to protect girls’ and women’s sports by codifying common-sense laws that ensure fair competition and keep women's titles out of men's hands.

energy.text: Feely supports expanding oil, natural gas, and coal production, saying energy independence can lower costs and create jobs.
energy.quote: Energy independence means lower costs for families, more jobs for Arizona workers, and greater national security.
